dedupe_keys.name: saref4ener etsi ontology for energy flexibility in smart appliances etsi ts 103 410 1

description: SAREF4ENER is an OWL-DL ontology that extends the Smart Applications REFerence ontology (SAREF) for the energy domain, published as ETSI technical specification TS 103 410-1 (version 2.1.1) and documented on the SAREF portal. It was created from the CENELEC standards EN 50631:2023 parts 1, 2, 3-1 and 4-1 and EN 50491-12-2, in collaboration with the Horizon 2020 project Interconnect and with industry associations including EEBUS, Energy@Home and the S2 consortium. The specification covers the device flexibility profile with power profile, demand driven, fill rate based, incentive table based and operation mode profiles, power limitation and power envelope profiles, load control, the flexibility request, offer and instruction communication, and data points and time series, with a class, object property, data property and named individual reference. Coverage is smart appliance and home energy management interoperability in Europe. Access: online documentation and ontology, free; the page notes ETSI IPR policy. Caveats: home-level flexibility semantics, not grid asset modelling. It suits capacity planning simulation of demand response and smart-home data exchange work, and relates to the IEC 61970-301 CIM record catalogued here.
